description: This file defines a custom Flask Blueprint class that extends SansioBlueprint, adding methods for static file handling, resource opening, and configuration-based cache control. It also sets up CLI command grouping.

classes.name: Blueprint
classes.description: A subclass of SansioBlueprint that adds Flask-specific functionality for static files, resource access, and CLI integration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Blueprint with parameters for static and template folders, URL prefix, subdomain, URL defaults, root path, and CLI group. Sets up an AppGroup for CLI commands.

methods.name: get_send_file_max_age
methods.description: Determines the max age for caching static files based on app configuration, supporting timedelta and integer values.

methods.name: send_static_file
methods.description: Serves static files from the static folder, raising an error if static folder is not set.

methods.name: open_resource
methods.description: Opens a resource file relative to the blueprint's root path in read mode, supporting binary and text modes with encoding.
